content: multilingual-e5 (intfloat) and BGE-M3 (BAAI) both top Russian MTEB IR section among sub-1B models. BGE-M3 is first model supporting dense+sparse+multi-vector retrieval in one, SOTA on MIRACL/MKQA cross-lingual. mE5-large beats Cohere multilingual-v3 by 0.4pt on MTEB avg. Both are open-weight, self-hostable, run on CPU for corpora this small.
